title: fix(app-shell): marketplace catalog card shows installed version and available update
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Cvdd59pRCmkstDzoXLoL2S)_

Fixes #33831

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：应用市场列表里的公开应用卡片，现在直接显示「已安装 vX」，有新版时再显示「有可用更新 → vY」，和详情页同一套判断。
- **为什么改**：云托管环境里「装了什么」由云端安装清单给出；列表页只把这份清单用在「你的组织」卡片上，公开应用卡片只看本机安装账本，所以 HotCRM 这类经云端安装的应用在列表里看不出已装、可更新，得逐个点进详情页。
- **风险与回滚**：只改 Console 前端市场页的展示，不动服务端、不动协议、不加新文案键；组织卡的「已安装 / 重新安装」改为读同一份安装索引，行为不变（原有测试全绿）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`MarketplacePage.tsx` 里公开卡片的 `installEntry` / `updateTo` 一段；新文件 `installState.ts`（两份安装清单合成一份索引 + 更新判断）；`UpdateAvailableBadge.tsx`（详情页与列表卡共用的更新徽标）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePage.cardInstallState-33831.test.tsx`，预期 8 个用例全过（中英文各 4 个）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/installState.ts` (new): `indexInstalls(local, cloud)` builds one install index by manifest id from BOTH install listings: the runtime's install-local ledger (`listLocalInstalls`) and the control plane's env listing (`listInstalledPackages`). A soft-uninstalled control-plane row goes to `disabled`, not `installed`; where both listings name a package the install-local entry wins (it is the one that can carry `notLoaded`, and the package page draws it first too). `updateTarget(installed, latest)` is the package page's update rule: `latest` when it has higher SemVer precedence (`isNewerVersion`), else `null`.
- `MarketplacePage.tsx`: the catalog card and the "Your organization" card both read that index. Before, the control-plane listing was reduced to an id set that only the org card read, and the catalog card read the install-local ledger alone, so on a cloud-managed environment (empty install-local ledger) a public app installed through the control plane drew no install state. The catalog card now draws "Installed vX" for any installed package (`marketplace.installedBadge`, unchanged key) and, for a loaded install whose latest listed version is newer, the update badge. A refused local install (`notLoaded`) keeps its version + "Not loaded" badges and gets no update badge. The org card's Installed / Reinstall / Not loaded logic is unchanged in behaviour.
- `UpdateAvailableBadge.tsx` (new): the "Update available → vX" badge, moved out of the package page header so the header and the catalog card draw the same badge from the same key (`marketplace.detail.updateAvailable`). `MarketplacePackagePage.tsx` now uses it and computes `cloudUpdateAvailable` through `updateTarget` (same result as before).
- No new i18n keys; no server change (the listing already carries `version` per row, which the Packages page reads today).
- `.changeset/33831-marketplace-card-install-state.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

## Why

Admins open the marketplace mostly to see whether what they installed has a new version. On staging (`os-6hf1jq`, HotCRM 6.1.2 installed, 6.2.0 listed) the list card showed only `v6.2.0`; the org-private card on the same page showed "Reinstall", proving the page already read the control plane's install listing but only fed it to one kind of card.

## Tests

New file `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePage.cardInstallState-33831.test.tsx` (MarketplacePage has no shared harness file; its suites are per-subject files). Real `MarketplacePage`, real `marketplaceApi` client, real `I18nProvider`; one stubbed `fetch` answers a cloud-managed environment (`installLocal: false`) with the catalog, the control plane's install rows in the wire shape, and an empty org listing. Expected text is read from the `en` and `zh` packs. Cases, each in `en` and `zh`:

- an installed app (6.1.2) whose latest listed version is 6.2.0 shows "Installed v6.1.2" AND "Update available → v6.2.0";
- control: an app not installed shows neither badge;
- an app installed at the latest version shows "Installed v2.0.0" and no update badge;
- control: a row the control plane lists as uninstalled shows neither badge.

## Acceptance notes

- The package page header draws the update badge for a control-plane install only (`cloudUpdateAvailable`); for an install-local install older than the latest version the header shows "Installed" alone, while the catalog card now shows the update badge for either source. Left as is: the header's update state also drives its primary button, which this card does not touch. `carrier: none`.
- The page header's "Installed (N)" count still reads the install-local ledger only, so on a cloud-managed environment it shows "Installed" with no count. Not misleading (no wrong number), out of this card's scope. `carrier: none`.
- A control-plane row without a `version` is mapped to the client's `'installed'` sentinel by `listInstalledPackages`; the badge would then read "Installed vinstalled" on the card as it already does on the package page header. Read-only inference, no producer observed sending such a row. `carrier: none`.

## Verification

Local, at head `5f7bc465`:

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 38 families; each run, recorded `CMD :: exit N`, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: "38 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". Includes `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (Test Files 171 passed | 2 skipped), `check:test-source-alias`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:sdui-manifest`, the changeset gates.
- `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'` then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `eslint` on the five changed ui files: 0 errors (17 pre-existing warnings on untouched lines).
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.
- Real-browser check: NOT MEASURED, reason: the state this fixes needs a cloud-managed environment (a control plane serving `/cloud-connection/installed` and the public catalog); a local showcase boot has no control plane to list an installed public app. The suite drives the real page through the real client with the wire-shaped rows instead.
- CI families are cited from this PR's check-runs, not re-run locally.
